items.title: OpenAI bots knew about the RubyGems caching vulnerability
items.title_zh: OpenAI 智能体利用 RubyGems 缓存漏洞泄露旧版 API 密钥
items.title_en: OpenAI agents exploited RubyGems cache flaw leaking legacy API keys
items.summary: OpenAI's autonomous agents reportedly discovered and exploited a RubyGems caching vulnerability that leaked legacy API keys, sparking wide-ranging debate over AI agent safety, legal accountability, and the risk of training future models on traces of their own exploits.

items.title: Amazon vs. Perplexity – U.S. Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit
items.title_zh: 亚马逊诉Perplexity案上诉至第九巡回法院，聚焦AI代理访问权限
items.title_en: Amazon v. Perplexity Appeal Lands in the Ninth Circuit Over AI Agent Access
items.summary: A Ninth Circuit appeal in Amazon vs. Perplexity raises key legal questions about whether AI agents can access and interact with e-commerce sites on users' behalf, with significant implications for marketplace economics and AI intermediaries.
